# AdaptTable

> Headless, UI-agnostic React data table: one declarative API (columns,
> filters, three data tiers) rendered natively by Mantine, MUI, Chakra UI,
> Ant Design, or your own Tailwind classes. URL-synced state, operator
> filters, column management, saved views, virtualization (50k rows), full
> i18n + RTL (10 locales), dark mode. MIT.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://orwa-mahmoud.github.io/adapttable/): install (npx @adapttable/cli init), providers, first table
- [Concepts](https://orwa-mahmoud.github.io/adapttable/concepts/): TableSource, data tiers, virtualization
- [Customization](https://orwa-mahmoud.github.io/adapttable/customization/): slots, classNames, theming per kit
- [URL state](https://orwa-mahmoud.github.io/adapttable/url-state/): adapters, urlKey namespacing, urlSync opt-out
- [API reference](https://orwa-mahmoud.github.io/adapttable/api/): every prop and headless hook
- [FAQ](https://orwa-mahmoud.github.io/adapttable/faq/)
- [Comparison](https://orwa-mahmoud.github.io/adapttable/comparison/): vs TanStack Table and kit-native tables
- [Full docs in one file](https://orwa-mahmoud.github.io/adapttable/llms-full.txt)

## Demo

- [Live demo](https://orwa-mahmoud.github.io/adapttable/demo/): all five adapters on one dataset
